name: Reviews and Rating – Docplanner
author: Anton Bergen

sections.description:
Showcase your patient reviews directly from Docplanner and boost credibility!
Docplanner is a leading healthcare platform where patients leave reviews about doctors and clinics. With Docplanner Reviews & Rating, you can seamlessly display these testimonials on your website, enhancing trust and attracting more patients.

Key Features

✅ Effortless Setup – Simply enter your Docplanner profile URL, and the plugin fetches your reviews automatically.
✅ Unlimited Reviews – Display as many reviews as you want on your website.
✅ Reviews Carousel – Showcase testimonials in an eye-catching slider.
✅ Rating Badge – Display your average rating dynamically based on patient feedback.
✅ Supports All Docplanner Regions – Works across multiple countries and platforms.
✅ SEO-Friendly – Improve your website’s online visibility.
✅ Mobile-Optimized – Fully responsive design for all devices.
✅ Customizable Widgets – Adjust styles to match your website’s look.

Why Use This Plugin?

✔ Build Trust & Credibility – Highlight positive patient experiences directly on your website.
✔ Increase Engagement – Encourage visitors to book appointments by showing real feedback.
✔ No Coding Required – Designed for doctors, clinics, and medical professionals with easy integration.

How It Works?

1️⃣ Install & activate the plugin.
2️⃣ Enter your Docplanner profile URL in the settings.
3️⃣ Set general settings like global color or date format.
4️⃣ Choose the widget type you want to display on your website.
5️⃣ Customize the widget with parameters like the number of reviews or pagination.
6️⃣ Copy the shortcode and paste it into your website.

🚀 Start displaying your Docplanner reviews today and grow your practice with social proof!

Usage

  1. Go to the ‘Docplanner’ menu in WordPress
  2. Enter your Docplanner Profile URL
  3. Use shortcodes to display reviews and rating on your website
sections.installation:
1. Unpack archive to the ‘wp-content/plugins/’ directory or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
